features: 【HEART RATE MONITORING】 Keep track of heart rate information conveniently from your wrist with the integrated heart rate monitoring feature. The M7 fitness band is designed to provide quick access to heart rate readings during your regular activities and exercise sessions. Its wearable design keeps important fitness information easily accessible, making it convenient to follow your daily activity routine and stay aware of your heart rate throughout the day.

【BLOOD PRESSURE MONITORING】 The built in BP monitoring function provides convenient access to blood pressure related readings directly from the wrist. It is designed as a practical tracking feature for everyday use when you want to check your activity related information in one place. The compact wristband format makes monitoring convenient during daily routines while keeping the tracking experience simple and accessible.

【STEP AND CALORIE COUNTER】 Track your everyday movement with integrated step and calorie counting functions. The step counter helps you keep an eye on walking activity throughout the day, while calorie tracking provides additional activity information for your regular fitness routine. Whether walking, exercising or completing everyday tasks, the band helps you stay more aware of your movement and maintain a consistent active lifestyle.

【WATERPROOF ACTIVITY BAND】 Designed with a waterproof construction for convenient everyday activity tracking, the M7 wristband can be worn during active daily routines where protection from water exposure is important. The wearable format makes it suitable for regular movement, walking and exercise sessions. Its practical design allows you to keep your activity tracker on your wrist while going through different parts of your daily routine.

【DAILY FITNESS TRACKING】 Keep multiple activity measurements conveniently together on your wrist with heart rate, BP, calorie and step tracking features. The M7 fitness smartwatch band is designed for users who want a simple way to follow their everyday movement and exercise information. It can become a useful part of a regular fitness routine by keeping commonly used tracking functions available in one compact wearable accessory.
